title: HR Trainee Fresher
description:
HR Trainee – Campus Recruitment \& Student Admissions Company: Neelavath Software Solutions Location: Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu Job Type: Full\-time \| Work from Office Experience: Fresher / 0–1 Year

Job Description We are looking for energetic and self\-motivated HR Trainees to join our growing team. The role involves conducting campus recruitment drives, building relationships with colleges, generating student walk\-ins, providing career counselling and converting prospective students into course admissions. This position is suitable for freshers interested in HR, campus recruitment, business development and the EdTech industry.

Key Responsibilities

1\. Campus Recruitment \& College Relations \* Coordinate with college placement officers and conduct campus recruitment drives. \* Organize placement activities, career guidance sessions and student engagement programs. \* Build and maintain relationships with colleges and placement cells.

2\. Lead Generation \& Student Walk\-ins \* Generate prospective student leads through campus drives, telecalling and promotional activities. \* Encourage students to visit our training centre. \* Follow up regularly with interested candidates and achieve walk\-in targets.

3\. Career Counselling \& Admissions \* Counsel students on software training, internships, certifications and placement opportunities. \* Explain course details, fees, training schedules and career prospects. \* Convert enquiries and walk\-ins into successful course admissions. \* Achieve monthly student enrolment targets.

4\. HR \& Administrative Activities \* Maintain student enquiry and admission records. \* Coordinate interviews, recruitment activities and training schedules. \* Prepare daily reports on leads, walk\-ins and admissions.

Candidate Requirements \* Any degree: BBA, MBA, B.Com, B.Sc, BE or equivalent. \* Freshers are welcome. \* Good communication and interpersonal skills. \* Interest in HR, recruitment, counselling and sales. \*

Willingness to travel to colleges for campus recruitment drives. \* Target\-oriented attitude and ability to work independently.

Pay: ₹8,000\.00 \- ₹12,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Commuter assistance
* Food provided
* Internet reimbursement

Work Location: In person
